title: API Inspector · Visual Refresh
brief: Three proposed visual directions for a Flutter HTTP inspector overlay. Modernize colors, inline icons, the floating launcher, timeline, routes, and request/response details without changing capture logic. Interactive sample data only; proposed palettes are not extracted project tokens. Panels remain at most 600 CSS pixels wide. Select a direction before any Flutter implementation.

artboards.title: 01 · Compact DevTools (recommended)
artboards.tradeoff: Crisp, dense rows and monospace metadata support frequent developer inspection; compact targets are less touch-oriented. Blue/indigo accents with a working light/dark preview.

artboards.title: 02 · Breathing Room
artboards.tradeoff: Spacious grouped request cards and larger controls favor touch and relaxed reading; fewer requests fit at once. Soft neutral/teal palette with a working light/dark preview.

artboards.title: 03 · Signal / Contrast First
artboards.tradeoff: Dark graphite, a timestamp rail, bright semantic labels, and separate request/response views maximize contrast with minimal chrome; less visually neutral inside a light host app.
